serviceDetails.title: How do you fit my washing machine?
paras: We connect the cold water supply, link the waste pipe to your drain, fit a new isolation valve where needed, and tidy the pipework. Then we level the washing machine so it sits firm and runs quietly, slide it into place and test it.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer plumbing in a washing machine in Watford

serviceDetails.title: Do you test for leaks?
paras: Yes. We check every joint and run a test cycle before we leave, so you know the washing machine fills, drains and runs properly. No leaks, no wobble, and ready to use.

serviceDetails.title: What if there is no plumbing in place?
paras: If your kitchen or utility room has no water or waste point for a washing machine, we can add one. We run a new water supply and waste pipe, fit a valve and connect the drain, so the washing machine can go where you want it.
serviceDetails.alt: New plumbing for a washing machine in a kitchen

serviceDetails.title: Can you fit a washer dryer?
paras: Yes. We fit washing machines and washer dryers. For a vented tumble dryer, we can fit a vent through the wall. For condenser dryers stacked on a washing machine, we fit a stacking kit so both sit safely.
serviceDetails.alt: Washing machine fitted in a Watford utility room

serviceDetails.title: Can you take my old washing machine away?
paras: Yes. We disconnect your old washing machine, cap the pipes if needed, and can take the old machine away and leave the space clear.
serviceDetails.alt: Old washing machine removed after a new fit

serviceDetails.title: Are your prices clear?
paras: Yes. You get a fixed price before we start, with no hidden extras. Tell us whether the plumbing is already in place, and whether you want the old machine removed, and we will give you a price.
serviceDetails.alt: Fixed price washing machine installation quote

serviceDetails.title: Why choose AR Heating?
paras: We are a local Watford company, trading since 2007, and every gas job is done under our Gas Safe registration, No. 574111. We give you a fixed price before we start, turn up when we say we will, and leave your home as clean as we found it. If something is not worth doing, we tell you.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe registered AR Heating engineer

serviceDetails.title: Why use a professional to fit a washing machine?
paras: Plumbing in a washing machine looks simple, but a loose joint or a badly placed waste pipe can leak slowly for weeks before you notice. By then, the water may have damaged your floor or the kitchen units. A poor waste connection can also let dirty water flow back into the machine. We fit it right the first time, test it, and check for leaks before we leave.
serviceDetails.alt: Leak under a washing machine from a poor fit

serviceDetails.title: How do I get ready for the fit?
paras: Clear the space where the washing machine will go, and make sure the old machine is empty. Keep the new washing machine in its box until we arrive, along with the hoses and fittings which came with it. If your kitchen is being fitted, let us know the date, and we can book the fit to suit your kitchen fitter.
serviceDetails.alt: New washing machine delivered ready for fitting

serviceDetails.title: What is an isolation valve and do I need one?
paras: An isolation valve lets you turn off the water to the washing machine without turning off the whole house. If the washing machine leaks, or needs moving or repairing, you can stop the water in seconds. If your kitchen does not have one, we fit one as part of the job.
serviceDetails.alt: Isolation valve for a washing machine water supply

serviceDetails.title: Where do you cover?
paras: We are based at Unit 24, The Roundway, Watford, WD18 6LB, and fit washing machines across Watford, Bushey, Rickmansworth, Hemel Hempstead, St Albans, Harrow, Pinner, Stanmore, Edgware, Ruislip and Northolt. We are Gas Safe registered (No. 574111), fully insured, and you can check our number on the Gas Safe Register before we arrive.
serviceDetails.alt: AR Heating engineer at a home in Watford

faqs.q: How long does the fit take?
faqs.a: Most fits take under an hour when the plumbing is already in place.
Yes. We test every joint and run a cycle before we leave.

faqs.q: Can you take my old washing machine away?
faqs.a: Yes. We can remove the old machine and clear the space.

faqs.q: Can you add plumbing if there is none?
faqs.a: Yes. We can run a new water supply and waste so the washing machine can go where you want.

faqs.q: Can you fit an integrated washing machine?
faqs.a: Yes. We plumb it in and work with your kitchen fitter on the door and panels.

faqs.q: Can you move my washing machine to another spot?
faqs.a: Yes. We can move the water and waste to a new spot, such as a utility room.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: Yes, someone needs to be home to let us in and check the washing machine before we leave.

faqs.q: Do I need an isolation valve?
faqs.a: Yes. It lets you turn off the water to the washing machine fast if it leaks. We fit one if you do not have one.

faqs.q: What do I need to do before you arrive?
faqs.a: Clear the space, empty the old machine, and keep the new washing machine and its hoses ready.

faqs.q: Can you fit a washing machine I bought online?
faqs.a: Yes. We fit machines bought from any shop. Keep the hoses which came with it.

faqs.q: Can you fit a washer dryer?
faqs.a: Yes. We fit washing machines and washer dryers, and can fit a stacking kit for a separate dryer.
